risk_note: RV2 by the gate (contract and generated route files beside notification, RV1). Implements the three planned inbox operations of CT-02t on the existing app.inbox_messages table (no migration): listMessages returns only the caller's messages (app_id and user_id), newest first by created_at then message_id, with an opaque cursor bound to the account and kept at microsecond precision (malformed, truncated or another account's cursor is 20001 fields=[cursor]); listing does not touch read_at. markMessagesRead marks with one UPDATE ... WHERE read_at IS NULL RETURNING inside a transaction (read_at = injected Clock, row_version + 1), so concurrent or repeated calls never double count; unknown and other accounts' ids are skipped silently (BR-ID-10: nothing about other accounts is revealed); it returns marked_count and the unread count left. getUnreadMessageCount counts the caller's unread rows. The static routes read and unread-count are matched before :message_id. Version gate and the h5 read-only scope come from the generated platform route tables. The planned flag is dropped from the three operations and the generated route schemas are regenerated. No money, no attribution.
